tftp_root.description: The root directory from which TFTP files are served. All client paths are relative to this directory.

listen_address.description: IP address the TFTP server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP (e.g., 192.168.1.10).

listen_port.description: UDP port number for TFTP requests. Standard is 69; do not change unless required by network constraints.

verbose.description: Whether to enable detailed logging (debug level) to syslog.

allow_write.description: Allow clients to upload new files to the server (write access). Set to false for read-only mode.

allow_overwrite.description: Allow clients to overwrite existing files. Only effective if write access is enabled.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent TFTP sessions. 0 means unlimited. Set a positive value to limit resource usage.

timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) before closing inactive connections. Adjust based on network latency and use case.

chroot_dir.description: Optional chroot jail directory. If specified, the server will drop root and chroot here after startup for security. Leave empty to disable chroot.

extra_daemon_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the tftpd-hpa daemon. Each string is a separate argument (e.g., '--umask=022').

items.description: A single command-line argument for the TFTP daemon (e.g., '--umask=022', '--secure').
